name: Amateurs
look: A four-panel webcomic in a 2x2 grid. Two white figures argue with blank speech bubbles, then turn in shock at an off-panel voice. One snaps at a hooded figure sitting at a table with a mug of beer, who turns around grinning wildly in a purple cloak.
use: Two people argue about who has it worse or who goes further at something, and a hooded stranger who is far beyond both of them dismisses them as amateurs. The argument fills the first panel's blank bubbles and the stranger gets a label.
slots: first arguer's line, left bubble in panel 1
second arguer's line, right bubble in panel 1
label for the hooded stranger who outdoes them both
examples: I only slept four hours last night
Me with three windows of 90 tabs each
describe: two stick figures arguing and a hooded guy calls them amateurs
comic of a cloaked figure at a tavern table mocking two people fighting
two guys argue about who is worse then a stranger outdoes them
what was that punk comic with the purple hood guy
white cartoon people shocked by a mysterious man with a beer
origin: A four-panel strip from the webcomic Owlturd Comix by the artist Shen.
